_comment: Single source of truth for Consumer & Retail 'Browse by category' buttons. Each category's `retailers` array is empty until James delivers the retailer e-commerce URLs. While a category has zero retailer links, its Browse button renders in a disabled 'Coming soon' state (NOT a dead link). To go live: fill the `retailers` array for a category, rebuild. No code edits, no Manus round-trip.
_status_rule: If retailers[] is empty -> button shows 'Coming soon' disabled state. If retailers[] has >=1 entry -> button is active; single entry links direct, multiple entries open a retailer chooser.
